content:
Rumors have indicated that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home product lineup for years, and a new leak has listed the products expected to launch.

macOS code leak mentions several unannounced Home devices

Apple's most important annual event is just weeks away, and several new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, as well as new Apple Watch models.

The new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are rumored to be on the way. But several other Home products could also be on the verge of launching.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC contains references to several unannounced products.

These include codenames related to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be a home hub version with a dock, while J491 is designed for wall-mounting."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The existing HomePod mini has the codename B520, so this is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Possibly the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: The next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products rumored to be in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic-style home hub. It remains unclear whether their codenames are included in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also discovered a codename "Pebble," believed to be the internal name for homeOS. Additionally, there is a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" that may be related to HomePad.

Finally, the leak also revealed an unspecified Home accessory available in four colors: Rose, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
